expectations: automated NotebookLM output generation (report, podcast, infographic)
replacing human citation checking in the essay workflow
context: area: .specify/memory/constitution.md (Principles II, III, V, IX, X need a v1.1.0 amendment)
area: scripts/ (ingest.sh, backup.sh, common.sh idiom for the kb.sh wrapper)
area: compose.yaml and .env (single config surface; new one-shot kb-sync service behind a profile, reranker service)
constraint: LightRAG reached only over its REST API; server unchanged except config
constraint: data invariant 1 and Principle V: removals need backup, log, and a held-removal safety limit
constraint: .env and .env.example stay byte-identical; comments on their own lines

FR-001.title: Constitution amended to v1.1.0 and README updated before feature code merges

FR-002.title: Sync tool talks to the knowledge base only through its REST API

FR-003.title: Sync tool runs containerised and does not start with the server

FR-004.title: Config in .env; secrets in an ignored owner-only file, never logged

FR-005.title: Item records under data/kb-sync/ included in backup and restore

FR-006.title: Pull only configured Drive folders and subfolders

FR-007.title: One Markdown store file per item at a stable path with provenance header

FR-008.title: One record per item with origin, fingerprint, doc ID, topics, notebook IDs, status

FR-009.title: Detect changes and re-process only changed items

FR-010.title: Delete-before-replace and upstream-delete removal, each after a backup and logged

FR-011.title: Hold removals over a configurable safety limit for confirmation

FR-012.title: Export Docs, download PDFs, convert spreadsheets; skip and report media; report failures

FR-013.title: Ingest byte-identical files once, recording every folder location

FR-014.title: Tag NotebookLM outputs; ingest text outputs, record audio and video only

FR-015.title: AppFlowy sign-in, page-tree walk, block-to-Markdown conversion

FR-016.title: AppFlowy databases as one table or one file per row

FR-017.title: Accept the leesinclair.dev research/ folder as a source

FR-018.title: Re-runnable sign-in per cloud source, named on expiry

FR-019.title: ask retrieves context only, filters locally, sends only survivors to Claude

FR-020.title: Reranker filter preferred, local-model scoring fallback, answer names the filter

FR-021.title: Citations as [n] Title (AppFlowy|Drive) link resolved through records

FR-022.title: Claude answers only from passages; no survivors means not in the knowledge base

FR-024.title: kb_search and kb_get_source tools for local Claude Code

FR-025.title: 20-question test set runnable with no filter, reranker, and local scoring

FR-026.title: Editable research pack file per topic

FR-027.title: Push pack creates notebook, adds sources, records IDs, respects source limit

FR-028.title: Review writes a proposal of drops, re-pushes and adds with reasons

FR-029.title: Apply only the approved proposal; unsupported drops recorded as pending

FR-030.title: Optional Claude web search for candidate adds

FR-031.title: Wrapper script in the repo idiom with uniform exit codes

FR-032.title: Nightly job with per-source isolation and a run summary

intent: Sync Drive and AppFlowy into a local Markdown store for LightRAG, answer with cited links via a local filter and Claude, and bridge topics to NotebookLM with reviewed pruning
